title: ReceiptRequest
description: Request for a session's signed receipt, written by the app to the station on BLE characteristic FFF6, inside the channel (profiles/offline/ble-transport.md §8). The session is named by its offlineTxId, which the station draws at random and sends only in the StartServiceResponse of the session's own connection: naming it is what entitles the app to the receipt. The station answers with a ReceiptResponse notified on FFF6.

offlineTxId.description: The offline transaction whose receipt the app asks for - the offlineTxId of the StartServiceResponse that started its session.
